name: Sealbound Galleries
introDiscord:
Portrait halls and armor galleries line the old palace.

Rows of stone knights stand beside painted nobility.

Several portraits now have paper mustaches.
introTwitch:
Portrait halls and armor galleries line the old palace.

Rows of stone knights stand beside painted nobility.

Several portraits now have paper mustaches.

sealbound-galleries-approach.prompt: Sealbound Galleries opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A Sealbound Squire steps from an armor display.

One nearby mannequin remains suspiciously innocent.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath a royal portrait.

The king has acquired a magnificent paper mustache.

Shizuki wrote:

'Historic restoration.

You're welcome.'

forward.message: A display cabinet contains Star Candies beside ceremonial medals.

sealbound-galleries-depths.prompt: Deeper within Sealbound Galleries, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
An old attendants' station contains restorative supplies.

Shizuki labeled it:

'Museum first aid.

For injuries caused by exhibits becoming violent.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A suit of armor turns toward you.

Museum policy remains terrible.

forward.message: A ceremonial chest rests beneath portraits of royal squires.

sealbound-galleries-threshold.prompt: Near Gallery of Vows, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message:
A glass cabinet holds Star Candies and an extremely fancy ceremonial
helmet.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle sits beneath a sketch of herself wearing the helmet.

'Too big.

Glimmer fit inside helmet.

Helmet immediately became house.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Sealbound Squire guards the final portrait hall.

boss-antechamber.name: Gallery of Vows
boss-antechamber.prompt: At Gallery of Vows, every suit of armor kneels.

bossPromptDiscord:
At Gallery of Vows, every suit of armor kneels.

One full-sized knight remains standing beneath an ancient royal oath.

Use /yes to approach, or /no to leave the museum's most
dedicated employee alone.
bossPromptTwitch:

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Gallery of Vows. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Knight lowers its weapon.

The gallery goes still.

The king's paper mustache survives.

Important victory.
